title: [v0.92.2][WP-01][planning] Publish and open the CodeFriend Beta 1 execution wave
goal: Reconcile all open existing issues from #720 through #862 into the v0.92.2 planning package without creating child issues.
required_outcome: A validated issue wave binds all existing work, preserves the canonical release tail, and identifies the remaining number-free creation list.
acceptance_criteria: All open #720-#862 issues are mapped exactly once; arithmetic is 51 total, 9 existing, 42 prospective; TAIL-01..10 is unchanged; no child issues are created.
inputs: Issue #864, live GitHub issue inventory, and docs/milestones/v0.92.2 planning package.
target_files_surfaces: docs/milestones/v0.92.2 planning catalog, WBS, issue wave, execution specifications, reconciliation, release and validation projections.
validation_plan: Run validate_planning.py --self-test, git diff --check, live issue inventory reconciliation, and independent pre-PR review.
demo_proof_requirements: No demo; deterministic documentation and issue-inventory proof only.
non_goals: No child issue creation, implementation, merge, release approval, or repository split.
notes_risks: Issue #848 decides repository decomposition but does not authorize split implementation.
